children: Binance Wallet announced on X that Pre-Access is only one part of its broader on-chain TradFi offering. The wallet said it provides a single, unified place to access a complete on-chain TradFi journey, including Pre-Access, RWAs, and related features. It said users do not need to switch between apps and described the experience as a more flexible way to invest on-chain. The announcement said financial access that was once limited by geography, wealth, or institutional privilege is now expanding to everyday users. The post did not provide additional product details, but said more information is coming soon. It also included an FAQ reference and asked users to stay tuned for further updates.

title: Binance Wallet Expands On-Chain TradFi Access With Pre-Access and RWAs
